results.title: Careers at Equal Parts
results.text:
Equal Parts — Reshaping Insurance with AI and Human Relationships

## Strong Relationships

### We acquire top-tier insurance agencies who value the importance of fostering deep relationships with clients.

### We equip them with transformative AI tools designed to extend their reach and amplify their impact.

# Innovative Technology That Propels Agents Into the Future

We deploy AI tools to ingest data and provide insights that can assist with cross-selling and upselling, customer acquisition, risk management, and more. So you can focus on building and maintaining close relationships with your customers.

## Mike Witte

### Founder & CEO

Mike Witte, an entrepreneur based in Austin, Texas, co-founded RigUp (now Workrise), scaling it from a two-person startup to a $3 billion company. Drawing on over a decade of experience, Mike is now entering the insurance industry, focused on leveraging relationships and technology to drive meaningful impact. Mike’s work reflects his commitment to empowering people and transforming industries.

## Graham Yennie

### Co-Founder & CTO

Graham Yennie, based in Pittsburgh Pennsylvania, is a seasoned data scientist and machine learning engineering leader with over twelve years of experience building AI platforms for business applications. He’s leveraging that background to help transform the status quo of managing an independent insurance agency.

## Mike Meller

### Co-Founder & COO

Mike Meller, a startup entrepreneur based in Austin, Texas, has built his career establishing technology driven networks in relationship driven industries. Mike has a proven track record of implementing business process technology, integrating acquired companies, and building go-to-market teams.

# We’re on a mission to become a top-5 insurance distributor within the next decade, challenging legacy incumbents by providing a unique opportunity for forward-thinking agents.

If you’re looking to elevate your career with the support of a dedicated team and a powerful platform, we invite you to join us on this journey.
